name: aw-individual-income-tax
description: Aruba individual income tax and wage tax table calculations for 2026. Covers the distinction between taxable income, annualized net wages and table income, progressive bands, the maximum annual tax-free amount, downward rounding and worked annual calculations. Use for questions about Aruba income tax brackets, loonbelasting, inkomstenbelasting or tabelinkomen. This is a calculation reference after the income base and allowance entitlement have been established. It does not determine residence, deductions, special income treatment, credits, return deadlines, monthly payroll withholding or social contributions. Official indexed guidance still requires direct source rechecking before release.
